name: Masala Roasted Chickpeas
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 1½ cups cooked chickpeas, drained and patted very dry
½ tsp each chilli powder, cumin powder and amchur
¼ tsp black salt and ½ tsp chaat masala
steps: Toss the chickpeas with the oil, spices and salt.
Spread on a tray and roast for 30 minutes, shaking every 10 minutes, until crisp.
Finish with chaat masala and lemon juice. Cool for 10 minutes; they crisp further as they cool.
note: A crunchy high-fibre snack that replaces fried namkeen. Store airtight and eat within 3 days.
